brief: The 5 analytics tools that actually matter for a SaaS under $1M ARR — everything else is noise.

slots.eyebrow: the only data stack you need
slots.desc1: Product analytics and session replay in one open-source platform.
slots.desc2: Ask questions about your data and share beautiful dashboards.
slots.desc3: Privacy-first web analytics without cookie banners or bloat.
slots.desc4: Monitor organic search performance and indexing health free.
slots.desc5: B2B SaaS analytics that auto-generates actionable growth reports.

slots.toolTagline: Open-source product analytics that captures every click, funnel, and replay.
slots.bigStatement: Understand exactly how users convert with autocaptured events and session replays.
slots.use1Body: See where users quit and fix friction in under five minutes.
slots.use2Body: Track new feature usage without writing custom tracking code.
slots.use3Body: Watch real user sessions to find bugs and UX blind spots.

slots.toolTagline: The easiest way for teams to ask questions and share insights.
slots.bigStatement: Turn your raw SQL into shareable dashboards the whole team actually reads.
slots.use1Body: Write queries once and let teammates explore results visually.
slots.use2Body: Schedule daily email reports to keep everyone aligned.
slots.use3Body: Click any chart to filter and segment data instantly.

slots.toolTagline: Lightweight, privacy-first web analytics without cookie banners or tracking bloat.
slots.bigStatement: Get instant site insights while respecting user privacy and page speed.
slots.use1Body: Track referral channels and campaign performance in real time.
slots.use2Body: See which blog posts drive signups and engagement.
slots.use3Body: Monitor entry and exit pages to optimize conversion paths.

slots.toolTagline: The only free tool that shows exactly how Google sees your site.
slots.bigStatement: Find high-intent keywords and indexing issues before they cost you leads.
slots.use1Body: Discover which searches bring traffic and where you rank.
slots.use2Body: Fix crawl errors and submit sitemaps directly to Google.
slots.use3Body: Monitor Core Web Vitals that impact search visibility.

slots.toolTagline: B2B SaaS analytics that turns product data into revenue insights automatically.
slots.bigStatement: Auto-generate activation and retention reports without a data team.
slots.use1Body: Track new user onboarding milestones and Aha moments.
slots.use2Body: Monitor customer engagement to predict churn before it happens.
slots.use3Body: Connect product usage directly to expansion and upsell opportunities.

slots.toolTagline: Subscription analytics that calculate your true SaaS metrics instantly.
slots.bigStatement: Know your MRR, churn, and LTV without building spreadsheets manually.
slots.use1Body: See monthly recurring revenue movements and cohort trends clearly.
slots.use2Body: Get notified when customers cancel or downgrade subscriptions.
slots.use3Body: Compare user cohorts to find your best acquisition channels.

slots.body: Drop the enterprise bloat. These six tools give you clarity without the invoice shock.
